title: Evidence fitness determines conclusion eligibility
unit_of_analysis: declared v0.6 claim and audit gate
sample: 15 material claims, five evidence gates, and one conclusion-eligibility state
transformation: Read the five categorical gate states and conclusion-eligibility result for each mapped claim, preserve the states without assigning a numeric score, and render letter labels with color.
claim_supported: Evidence fitness and dependency closure determine whether a traceable claim can enter a conclusion. The versioned Oko correction closes the prior failure within the declared single-assessor procedure.
prohibited_interpretation: The matrix supplies no aggregate trust score, source-truth determination, independent reliability estimate, or ranking of claims.
